data.why: The repo ships no example FCS data and generates test fixtures in-memory with fcswrite at test time only, so a realistic small FCS file must come from the stock set.

goals: Inspect the event count, channel names, and signal types (Area/Height/Width) captured in a single flow cytometry acquisition
Compare two FCS runs side by side to spot differences in channels or event counts between them
Generate a 96-well plate heatmap of per-well event counts to spot low-yield or failed wells
Verify that FCS filenames correctly encode their plate well position before running plate-level analysis

review.summary: The tree models the Explore and Compare tabs faithfully, with clean general labels and screens that support it. But the plate heatmap, the tool's main way of spotting low-yield or failed wells, was never reached, and the Analyze phase and f3 are built around the fallback warning. The heatmap and parsed-well results need to be captured with well-named copies of the test file, and some padding actions and miscited screens need cleaning up before this is filed.
